name: background-stripes
summary: Repeating stripe pattern as a background, optionally over an image.

arguments.name: $color
accepts: one colour, or several for a multi-stripe pattern, each a colour, currentColor, a system colour or a function such as var() or color-mix()

arguments.name: $thickness
accepts: stripe thickness: a length, or var(), env() or a calculation such as calc() or clamp()

arguments.name: $rotation
accepts: an angle in deg, grad, rad or turn, in any case, written as it is
a unitless number, which is treated as degrees
any other unit, such as px or %, is refused, because the gradient would be dropped

arguments.name: $image
accepts: an image path to sit behind the stripes, written unquoted unless it holds a space, a parenthesis or a quote, which are quoted
var(), url(), image-set() or a gradient, written as they are rather than wrapped in url()
